# PromptGather.io

> > A comprehensive resource for AI video generation, featuring case studies, tutorials, and prompts for tools like veo3, Seedance 2.0, and other AI video creation platforms.

PromptGather.io provides practical examples, optimization techniques, and creative prompts for AI-generated video content across genres including fantasy, sci-fi, commercial production, and cinematic storytelling. The site features detailed case studies demonstrating prompt engineering, lighting techniques, camera work, and production workflows using leading AI video generation tools.

## Key Topics

- veo3
- Seedance 2.0
- AI video generation
- prompt optimization
- lighting techniques
- camera angles
- video production
- storytelling
- Midjourney
- DeepBrain
- RunwayML
- cinematography
- content creation
- visual effects
- commercial production
